headlines.title: Virginia Chamber of Commerce promotes study touting Dominion merger benefits
headlines.summary: If the merger between Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy comes to fruition, Virginia could gain thousands of jobs, according to an economic analysis study conducted for the Virginia Chamber of Commerce. The report was created by Mangum Economics, a Northern Virginia-based consulting firm that assesses industries and their overall economic impacts.

headlines.title: Faith Leaders Urge SCC to Reject Dominion-NextEra Merger
headlines.summary: Faith leaders and community advocates gathered outside the Virginia State Corporation Commission (SCC) today to oppose NextEra Energy's proposed $67 billion acquisition of Dominion Energy, calling on state regulators to reject a deal that prioritizes the profit margins of one of the wealthiest corporations on earth over of the needs of working families, small businesses and communities in the Commonwealth.

headlines.title: GE Vernova vs. NextEra Energy: Which Industrials Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Both companies are riding the rising demand for electricity. GE Vernova builds the equipment, while NextEra Energy runs a large Florida utility and builds solar, wind, and battery projects.

headlines.title: NextEra Energy vs. Duke Energy: Which Dividend Utility Wins the AI Power Boom?
headlines.summary: NextEra offers stronger earnings growth, while Duke trades cheaper and pays a higher dividend. Both stand to benefit from rising AI power demand.

headlines.title: Mine, Enrich, Build, Operate: Which Link in the Nuclear Supply Chain Is the Best Stock Right Now?
headlines.summary: With demand for electricity growing at a rapid clip, nuclear power is increasingly important.

description: NextEra Energy, Inc., through its subsidiaries, generates, stores, transmits, distributes, and sells electric power to retail and wholesale customers in North America. It operates through Florida Power & Light Company (FPL) and NEER segments. The company generates electricity from wind, solar, nuclear, natural gas, and other clean energy assets. It also invests in generation, storage, transmission, and distribution facilities; owns, develops, constructs, manages, and operates generation facilities, including renewables, nuclear and natural gas, and battery storage facilities in the wholesale energy market in the United States and Canada, as well as electric and gas transmission assets, and natural gas pipelines; provides full energy and capacity requirement services; markets and trades in energy-related commodities; and participates in the production of natural gas, natural gas liquids, and oil. As of December 31, 2025, the company had approximately 35,963 megawatts of net generating capacity; approximately 93,000 circuit miles of transmission and distribution lines; and 932 substations. It serves approximately 12 million people through approximately 6 million customer accounts on the east and lower west coasts of Florida. The company was formerly known as FPL Group, Inc. and changed its name to NextEra Energy, Inc. in 2010. NextEra Energy, Inc. was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Juno Beach, Florida.
